data.name: Rudrika
data.short_meaning: Woman who delights in the Rudra God
data.long_meaning:
Woman who delights in the Rudra God (Shiva)
In Hindu mythology, Rudra is the god of destruction and the lord of the cremation ground.
This name is derived from the word 'Rud' which means roar, and the suffix 'ka' which means 'the one who'.
Thus, the name Rudrika signifies a woman who is devoted to Rudra or Lord Shiva.
data.spiritual_meaning: Devotion to Lord Shiva, destruction and transformation, creativity and expression

data.cultural_impact: Aruna is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the word 'arun,' which means red or ruddy in color. Aruna is the name of the charioteer of the Sun God Surya in Hindu mythology. historical_references.reference: Rudra, the god of primal energy and terror, was often invoked by name as Rudra-Rudhra, Rudraka or Rudrika during Vedic rituals. These names were also used during the Shiva Purana and the Mahabharata, indicating a continuity of use in Hindu tradition from the Vedic period to the medieval era.
historical_references.time_period: Vedic (c. 1500–500 BCE) to medieval (c. 6th-13th century CE)

historical_references.reference: Rudraka was also a surname used by the Vedic Brahmin families. The Rudrakas mentioned in the Rigveda were likely the priests responsible for invoking and appeasing the god Rudra during Vedic rituals. In later Hindu texts, the name Rudraka is also used to refer to Shiva, further emphasizing the continuity of Rudra with Shiva as the god of primal energy and destruction.

trends: Goddess of fertility and childbirth, Rudra (Shiva's wife) is known as Rudrika. In modern times, Rudrika is revered as a symbol of fertility and prosperity.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern Hindu culture, Rudrika is revered as a symbol of fertility and prosperity. She is primarily worshipped during Navratri, a nine-day festival dedicated to the worship of nine forms of the divine feminine. During this time, Hindus decorate and offer prayers to Rudrika idols, perform special rituals, and seek her blessings for a healthy and prosperous life.
